definitions.explanation: A place where alcoholic drinks are served.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{酒場|さかば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: After work, I stopped by a bar.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{酒場|さかば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many old bars on this street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大衆|たいしゅう}→大衆：10150_taishuu⟧{酒場|さかば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{飲|の}める→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: You can drink cheaply at a public bar.

notes:
{酒場|さかば} is a general term for a bar or tavern where alcohol is served.

Common collocations:
- {大衆|たいしゅう}{酒場|さかば} (public bar, working-class bar)
- {酒場|さかば}で{飲|の}む (to drink at a bar)
- {酒場|さかば}に{行|い}く (to go to a bar)

Related words for drinking establishments:
- バー (bar - often Western-style)
- {居酒屋|いざかや} (izakaya - Japanese-style pub with food)
- スナック (snack bar - hostess bar)
- {飲|の}み{屋|や} (drinking place - casual term)
- パブ (pub)
